    Eating Out Guide

    Stay on track anywhere

    • Decide before you arrive. Look at the menu online and pick your meal ahead of time.
    • Build your plate. Protein first, then vegetables, then a smaller portion of carbs.
    • Sauces on the side. Ask for dressings and sauces on the side so you control the amount.
    • Grilled over fried. Choose grilled, baked, or roasted instead of fried or crispy.
    • Box half early. If portions are big, set half aside before you start eating.
    • Eat a little before you go. A protein snack helps you arrive hungry, not starving.
    • One plate, built well. Start with protein and vegetables, then add what you enjoy.
    • Bring a dish you trust. Offer something that fits your plan so you always have a good option.
    • Focus on people. Fellowship away from the food table and keep a water in your hand.
    • Enjoy the treat you love. Have a small portion of your favorite, then move on. Alignment over perfection.
    • Grill and wrap. Choose a grilled chicken sandwich or wrap and skip the creamy sauces.
    • Bowl it up. Ask for extra protein and vegetables with a lighter scoop of rice.
    • Smart breakfast. Egg sandwiches or egg bites, with coffee light on sugary add ins.
    • Pack a backup. Keep protein bars, nuts, jerky, or fruit in your bag or car.
    • Log it anyway. Snap your meal so the app still counts it. Every meal logged is data, not judgment.

    Easy swaps

    FriesSide salad or vegetables
    Fried chickenGrilled chicken
    Soda or sweet teaSparkling or flavored water
    Creamy dressingVinaigrette or salsa
    Large portionSmall, or share it

    Questions

    Frequently asked

    I missed a day, or a whole week. Do I start over?

    No. You pick up with your very next meal or workout. Log it, message me, and keep going. Consistency over time matters more than a perfect streak.

    Do I have to hit my macros exactly?

    Aim for close, not perfect. Get your protein in first, then let carbs and fats land near your targets. Being within range most days is a win.

    How do I log a meal I can't find in the app?

    Use Snap your meal and let the app estimate it, or pick the closest match and adjust the portion. A good estimate beats skipping the log.

    The scale went up. What happened?

    Daily weight moves with water, salt, sleep, stress, and hormones. Watch your weekly trend, your measurements, and your progress photos together for the real story.

    Do I need supplements?

    Food comes first. Supplements can fill gaps, so start with the Vitamins and Supplements Guide in the Vault and check with your doctor before adding anything new.

    What if something hurts during a workout?

    Stop the exercise. Muscle effort is normal, but sharp or joint pain is not something to push through. Message me so we can adjust, and see your doctor if the pain continues.

    When should I message my coach?

    Anytime you have a question, a win, or a hard day. Tap Message your coach in the app. You are not bothering me. This is what I am here for.
